title: Execute Raw SQL
description: Runnable demos of safe raw SQL execution: parameterized queries, dynamic IN clauses, identifier whitelisting, and bulk inserts. Uses sqlite3 / node:sqlite so everything runs with zero external services.
description_es: Demos ejecutables de SQL crudo seguro: consultas parametrizadas, cláusulas IN dinámicas, whitelist de identificadores e inserts masivos. Usa sqlite3 / node:sqlite para correr todo sin servicios externos.
